step1_figure.description: A 1st-order Delta-Sigma Modulator used to measure the current of a floating-gate memory cell. It integrates the difference between a reference current and the cell current on the bitline capacitance, using a clocked comparator as a 1-bit ADC and a counter for decimation.

mean_vbit.description: Average voltage of the bitline, regulated by the negative feedback of the DSM loop.

equation.explanation: The negative feedback loop of the Delta-Sigma Modulator forces the average bitline voltage to match the reference voltage.
equation.assumptions: Loop is stable and operating within its dynamic range.

sky130_expected.calculation: VREF is explicitly set to 500mV in the netlist.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The comparator will toggle to keep the bitline voltage oscillating tightly around the 500mV reference.

vbit_ripple.description: Peak-to-peak voltage ripple on the bitline due to current integration.

equation.explanation: The voltage change on the bitline capacitor during one clock cycle depends on the net current (Iref - Icell or just Icell) and the clock period.
equation.assumptions: Constant current charging/discharging during the clock cycle.

sky130_expected.calculation: Iref = 1uA, Icell = 0.5uA. Net charging current = 0.5uA. Cbit = 2pF. Assuming a 100MHz clock (Tclk = 10ns), dV = (0.5uA / 2pF) * 10ns = 2.5mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ripple depends on the clock frequency, but for typical memory sensing clocks (10-100MHz), it will be in the low millivolt range.

power.description: Average power consumption of the sensing circuit.

equation.explanation: Total power is the sum of static power (bias currents) and dynamic power (comparator and counter switching).

sky130_expected.calculation: Static current = Ibias (1uA) + Iref mirror (1uA) = 2uA. Dynamic current from comparator and 5-bit counter at 100MHz is approx 10-30uA. Total current ~20uA. Power = 1.8V * 20uA = 36uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the dynamic switching power of the StrongARM latch and the digital counter.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the mean bitline voltage, bitline ripple, and average power consumption of the DSM sensing circuit.
